IN DEVELOPMENT

Customer Retention Decision Analytics

Turning churn risk into better retention decisions.

FOCUS & METHODS

SQL / Explainable ML / Experimentation

View media gallery ↗

Problem & intended user

Help an analytics team understand customer churn and evaluate retention interventions.

Data & workflow

A planned workflow connects SQL analysis with feature exploration, PCA, churn modeling, SHAP explanations, and A/B testing.

Design decisions

Separate prediction from intervention evaluation: a high churn score alone does not establish that an intervention will work.

Evaluation approach

Use held-out discrimination and calibration checks, segment-level error analysis, and experiment uncertainty estimates.

Results & evidence

No verified benchmark results are published here yet.

Limitations & next steps

Document the dataset, complete reproducible evaluation, and publish decision-oriented findings.
